title: warn! level used for successful startup cleanup is misleading
description: cleanup_tmp_files logs 'relay queue: removed orphan tmp file from previous crash' at warn! level (line 218) for successful deletion. A successful cleanup operation — the crash-recovery path working as designed — should be logged at info! level. warn! implies something is wrong and requires attention; info! communicates 'system recovered correctly, here is what it found'. Operators monitoring warn logs will get false alerts on normal startup-after-crash.
